results.title: u know i luv u
results.overview: Bill Plympton's iconic, surreal hand-drawn animation is a companion to indie band average friends' latest single.

results.title: Fantasy Art. Luis Royo, Romulo Royo, Goya
results.original_title: Fantasy Art. Luis Royo, Romulo Royo, Goya
results.overview: Luis Royo, one of the world's leading fantasy art illustrators -an artistic style that encompasses sword-and-sorcery, science fiction, strange creatures, and the grotesque- and Romulo Royo, an internationally renowned painter, embark on a journey to Italy inspired by the most fantastic side of Francisco de Goya. We enter a universe of beauty, struggles, heroes, and heroines that goes beyond his canvases.

results.title: fracture summer
results.overview: The choreography of an injured summer. Sunlight moves through rooms, my period marks time passing, and PTSD rearranges the clock. My broken Super 8 camera needs to be shaken for the shutter release to catch, and I wonder how to stay functioning, myself. The document of being unable to walk during an especially Crip summer inside my apartment.

results.overview: Takarazuka Revue Flower Troupe production of the Austrian musical 'Elisabeth'.

results.title: MORELIFE
results.overview: A young man's plan to jump into an icy river at night is interrupted by a half-man half-fish there for the same reason. These two strike a bargain to find a rare Morel mushroom hoping it will provide something worth living for.

results.title: The Hunting Blind
results.overview: Two friends reunite at their old hunting blind. But soon, one of them will begin to wonder if they are the only ones there...

results.title: Border
results.overview: Holding onto the promise of a new life beyond the border, a young man follows a smuggler through a remote and unforgiving landscape, only to encounter the unexpected.

results.title: Clementine Orange
results.overview: Angelica has fallen in love with John, a prisoner whose letters and photos have sparked fantasies of a dangerous, forbidden love. When John is granted a 24-hour release and they finally meet for the first time, her illusion shatters - John has catfished her. Despite the betrayal, Angelica decides to give him a chance, if only for those fleeting 24 hours.

results.title: Going Home Project: Ravel & Shostakovich in Cinema
Super Scam Me
results.overview: After years of reporting on the scam industry, Mariana van Zeller enters one of her most immersive investigations to date. In a real-life social experiment, she builds a new online dating persona and goes undercover as the target of a romance scam to understand and expose the tactics, technologies, and psychological manipulations these criminals utilize to deceive their victims.

results.title: Heroic: Sabin Howard Sculpts the National WWI Memorial
results.original_title: Heroic: Sabin Howard Sculpts the National WWI Memorial
results.overview: Imagine watching Michelangelo paint the Sistine Chapel. HEROIC is a heart-palpitating behind-the-scenes look into the studio of Master Sculptor Sabin Howard as he races a deadline to complete a lifetime project in just 4 years: with the world watching. One sculptor's brute force talent in the face of an impossible task-- a visionary punching up through the bureaucracy. It's not just about the art: sculpting serves the world in honoring veterans. Conflict in the studio: everybody gives everything. Love, betrayal, treachery. Who will rise and who will fall?

results.title: Rust
results.overview: Accidentally locked out of the theater just minutes before curtain, two young actors and ex-lovers are forced to confront the unspoken truths of their breakup and the fear of a future about to tear them apart.

results.title: Loulou
results.overview: Grieving his father, eight-year-old Sam chases a butterfly, saves it from a lake, and tries everything to keep his new companion LouLou alive.

results.title: Stuck
results.overview: A visit to her brother Daan takes a dark turn when Emma discovers that he has become rooted in a field on his farm.

results.title: MaeBee : The Camping Trap
results.overview: Mae plans to reunite her parents on a camping holiday.

results.title: The Last Sun
results.overview: In a world where the sun has vanished, Gibraltar holds the last ray of light. Lena, a scientist, confronts her past and a rival as she fights to protect humanity's only remaining hope.

results.title: Black Holes
results.overview: Across a desolate mountain landscape, two sightless figures embark on a journey toward a solitary tree whose living eyes have watched over the world for centuries.
